The DPR 2 comparison command completed with exit code 1 before the 60-minute job limit; this was not a job-budget cancellation.

The screenshot timeout explicitly reached fonts loaded. No failure-time font inventory, pending-request snapshot, trace or HAR was retained; an unresolved font request is not established.
No retry, timeout change, native gate exemption, renderer promotion, hardware-GPU claim or performance inference is made.
